content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "Mission Shakti is a scheme in mission mode aimed at strengthening interventions for women safety, security and empowerment [E02]. It seeks to realize the Government's commitment for 'women-led development' by addressing issues affecting women on a life-cycle continuum basis and making them equal partners in nation-building through convergence and citizen-ownership [E02]. The scheme has two sub-schemes: 'Sambal' (for safety and security of women, including One Stop Centre, Women Helpline, and BetiBachaoBetiPadhao) and 'Samarthya' [E02]. Mission Shakti aims to make women economically empowered, exercising free choice over their minds and bodies in an atmosphere free from violence and threat, while reducing care burden on women and increasing female labour force participation through skill development, capacity building, financial literacy, and access to micro-credit [E02]. The scheme is implemented through dedicated Program Management Units (PMUs) at Central, State, and District levels, with the Central level having a National Hub for Empowerment of Women (NHEW) consisting of 26 specialists [E03].", "cited_evidence_ids": ["E02", "E03"], "claim_to_evidence": [{"claim": "Mission Shakti is a scheme in mission mode aimed at strengthening interventions for women safety, security and empowerment", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}, {"claim": "It seeks to realize the Government's commitment for 'women-led development' by addressing issues affecting women on a life-cycle continuum basis", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}, {"claim": "The scheme has two sub-schemes: 'Sambal' and 'Samarthya'", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}, {"claim": "Mission Shakti aims to make women economically empowered and reduce care burden on women", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}, {"claim": "The scheme is implemented through dedicated Program Management Units at Central, State, and District levels", "evidence_ids": ["E03"]}]}
